launches.title: Apollo Atomics: The Modern Nuclear Company
launches.tagline: Compact nuclear reactors for companies that can't wait for the grid.
launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We're [Assil](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aahalimi/) and [Drew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/drewwalkerrr/) — co-founders of [Apollo Atomics](https://www.apolloatomics.com).

### TL;DR

Apollo Atomics took the pressurized water reactor technology that already powers 80% of the world's nuclear plants and flipped one part, the steam generator, to make the plant an order of magnitude smaller without compromising power. That single change turns a decade-long construction project into a factory-built machine that fits on a truck. We've built a working demonstrator, tested it, and our fuel is already critical before July 4th.

We put the whole story into just over two minutes — it's the clearest version of what we're building we've made so far: ▶️ <https://youtu.be/vy8y_t1KAK4?si=FmGF4Q7w6eFkn4No>

### The Problem

The existing nuclear playbook doesn't work for customers who need power now.

* Gigawatt-scale nuclear takes 10+ years and \~$20B per plant.
* Most Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) in development rely on exotic fuels, unproven coolants, or supply chains that don't exist yet.
* Customers who need power in 2030 are being told to wait until 2035+ and hope.

Data centers, industrials, and utilities have demand today — and no credible nuclear option that can ship on their timeline.

### Our Solution

Apollo builds compact pressurized water reactors — the same technology that runs \~80% of the world's nuclear plants today. The difference is that our reactor is roughly 40x more compact, because we shrank only one component: the steam generator.

We keep everything the NRC has already licensed dozens of times — light water, low-enriched uranium, fuel, and components from existing qualified supply chains. The innovation is a single part: the steam generator.

Our Compact Steam Generator (CSG) replaces the massive, hand-built steam generator at the heart of a conventional PWR with a component 20x smaller, delivering the same thermal power — pre-tested, transportable, and contracted at a fixed price. That one change is what takes a reactor from a decade-long construction project to a factory-built machine deployable in less than 24 months.

Our product roadmap is three reactors, each on a truck, each for a different customer segment:

* A-10 — 10 MWe
* A-50 — 50 MWe
* A-300 — 300 MWe

### Our Ask

If any of these are you, we'd love to talk:

* Data center operators and hyperscalers sourcing 24/7 firm power for 2028–2035 deployment.
* Industrial offtakers (chemicals, refining, heavy manufacturing) needing process heat or behind-the-meter electricity.
* Utilities evaluating SMRs for grid-connected generation.

👉 Reach us at [ahalimi@apolloatomics.com](mailto:ahalimi@apolloatomics.com) and [drew@apolloatomics.com](mailto:drew@apolloatomics.com).
